chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abi Wallad, from Abi ʿAbdillah عليه السلام, who said:
ʿAli عليه السلام used to say: “The blood money for accidental killing is collected over three years, and the blood money for intentional killing is collected within one year.”

key_terms.الْخَطَإِ: accidental mistake; unintentional killing or harm
key_terms.الْعَمْدِ: intentional act; deliberate killing or harm
key_terms.ثَلَاثِ سِنِينَ: three years; the period over which the diyah of accidental killing is paid
key_terms.دِيَةُ: blood money; the prescribed financial compensation for unlawful killing or injury
key_terms.سَنَةٍ: one year; the period within which the diyah of intentional killing is paid

ai.seo_question: How long is the payment period for the diyah of accidental versus intentional killing in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding the schedule for paying diyah. It distinguishes between accidental and intentional cases, assigning three years for the diyah of mistake and one year for the diyah of intentional harm.
